# Retrospective - First month of network vans

Review of January 2026, the first month after the [[Thistle Run|courier consolidation]] replaced Ridgeway and the county van.

## What improved

Average time from hold placed to item on the shelf fell from 3.4 days to 2.1 days. Branches report fewer lost bins because every bin now passes through one sorting room.

## What did not

Eastgate holds were late most of the month because of the stop order, fixed in the [[Delivery routes working session, 2026-02-18]]. Overweight bins caused one driver injury. One van was out for three days with a brake repair, and holds backed up at Pinecrest.

## Follow-ups

Repacking training at every branch, and a second look at a Saturday run in the fall.
